ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominance with approximately 92% dark-to-black pixels and 8% high-intensity white-to-light-grey pixels concentrated in scarring and tip regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white mottling localized at the extreme distal tips; sparse distribution of circular white focal spots (rosettes) in the mid-lobe regions; linear high-contrast streaks (rake marks) predominantly on the right lobe and central-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 55-65 degrees, exhibiting a deep penetration into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude peaks (jagged edges) on the upper lateral margin of the left lobe and lower lateral margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve transitioning to a steep upward sweep at the distal terminals, forming sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (5-12px diameter) detected on the medial surface of the left lobe and upper distal surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several sets of parallel high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) visible on the right lobe oriented diagonally; multiple singular horizontal and vertical linear disruptions on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and rake marks likely resulting from inter-species interactions; significant depigmentation/mottling at the trailing edge boundaries and tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, irregular jagged indentation on the far-left trailing edge near the tip; concentrated cluster of white spots near the lower-right median notch boundary.
